design_philosophy: Athletic, outdoorsy, and energetic. Combining the organic feel of the Swedish Bergslagen forest with the high-performance vibe of an ultramarathon. Contrast is key: earthy base tones punctuated by high-visibility 'Bergslagen Orange' (from the logo). Using E1's Hybrid Rule: custom expressive HTML/Tailwind for the landing page, and heavily customized Shadcn UI for the registration, admin, and results forms.

typography.guidelines: Never use Inter for headings. Keep headings tight (tracking-tighter) to feel athletic and punchy. Labels should be small, uppercase, and widely tracked.

colors.guidelines: Use 'Tinted Grey' rule: Grays are tinted with green/brown to feel like stone and moss. Avoid generic blue-grays. The primary accent (#FF5A00) is strictly for primary CTAs, active states, and energetic highlights. Do not overuse it.

layouts_and_spacing.general: Generous spacing philosophy. Use p-8 to p-24 for section padding to give breathing room. Mobile-first responsive grids.
layouts_and_spacing.landing_page: Bento Grid Protocol (Mode A) for showcasing distances (47km, 14km, 6km) and charity info (Barndiabetesfonden). Asymmetry and overlapping elements. The hero section must use a max overlay of bg-black/40 over the background image to keep the forest visible.
layouts_and_spacing.dashboard_and_results: High Density Grid (Mode B). Dense, functional, and clear for the Start List and Results pages. Tight gaps (gap-4).
layouts_and_spacing.containers: Use sharp edges or very subtle rounding (rounded-md max 6px) to maintain an athletic, rugged feel. Avoid pillowy, overly soft radiuses.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Solid Backgrounds with a sharp 1px border. No glassmorphism on data-heavy tables to prevent visual refraction. Use 'Tracing Beam' or subtle neon-orange highlight borders on the active distance selection cards.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Minimalistic. Use sharp drop-shadows (e.g., 4px 4px 0px rgba(26,36,33,1)) on marketing buttons to give a physical, rugged 'trail' button feel.
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle noise overlay (grain) on the hero section to kill digital flatness and enhance the outdoor forest vibe.

components.navigation: Sticky white header (bg-white/95 backdrop-blur-md) with 1px bottom border. Logo on left, navigation links centered, 'Register Now' CTA on right. Mobile uses a clean slide-out menu.
components.buttons: Sharp corners or rounded-sm. Primary: bg-[#FF5A00] text-white hover:bg-[#E04F00] transition-colors. Add a subtle translate-y-[-2px] on hover.
components.forms: Use Shadcn forms. Inputs should have a solid bg-white, 1px border-[#D3D7D4], and on focus: ring-2 ring-[#FF5A00] border-transparent. Never use native datepickers; use Shadcn Calendar.
components.tables: For Start List and Results: Use Shadcn Table. Zebra striping with very faint green-grey (bg-[#F5F5F0]/50) for readability. Left-align textual data, right-align times.
components.cards: Cardless or flat cards with 1px border and no shadow. Use for distance selection (Radio Group style).

motion.guidelines: Micro-interactions are mandatory. Buttons lift on hover. Form validation messages slide down smoothly. List items in Start/Results table stagger in on mount. Do not use 'transition: all'.

accessibility.guidelines: All text must pass APCA/WCAG AA contrast. Orange (#FF5A00) on White is accessible for large text and UI components. Ensure focus rings are highly visible. Respect prefers-reduced-motion.

image_urls.description: Bergslagsleden Ultra Logo. Place in header and footer.
Dynamic trail runner in forest. Use as the main hero background with a bg-black/40 overlay.
Calm Swedish forest path. Good for the Charity/Barndiabetesfonden section background or footer.
Group of runners/finish line. Use as a smaller hero image for the Results or Start List page.

media.guidelines: Images must have max-h-[80vh] on mobile to prevent blocking content. Do not use placeholder images.

specific_page_instructions.landing_page: Hero section must boldly display '12 September 2026' and 'Bergslagsleden Ultra'. Highlight the 47km main distance. Include a section for the charity 'Barndiabetesfonden'.
specific_page_instructions.registration_form: Responsive form. Fields: Name, Birthdate (Shadcn Calendar), Club (or unattached), Nationality, Email, Distance selection (47km, 14km, 6km - rendered as large clickable cards). Conditional fields: If 47km is selected, show toggle/checkbox for 'Medal after finish' and 'Bus transfer Ånnaboda-Digerberget'. If 6km/14km is selected, these addons are hidden or marked N/A.
specific_page_instructions.admin_dashboard: Clean, distraction-free UI for officials. Input field for 'Bib Number' (deltagarnummer) that auto-populates Name and Club. Input field for 'Finish Time'. Submit button. Must include a data-testid='admin-time-submit'.
specific_page_instructions.results_page: Beautiful, filterable Shadcn table. Tabs to switch between 47km, 14km, and 6km. Columns: Rank, Name, Club, Time. First place highlighted.

testing.guidelines: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute. Example: data-testid='register-submit-button', data-testid='distance-47km-card'.

universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: Do not converge toward generic outputs. Use the defined typography (Outfit & Manrope).
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and crisp borders.
Do not apply universal transitions (transition: all).
Do not center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }).
Use modern button styles (sharp or rounded-sm) with interaction animations.
Never use AI assistant Emoji characters.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
Prioritize Shadcn UI for forms, selects, calendars, and tables. Do not use raw HTML selects or date inputs.
